trials.claim: Lifetime access to SEOPilot SaaS is included in this deal
trials.claimQuote: Get lifetime access to the SEOPilot SaaS today!
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow SEOPilot to terminate access at any time, with or without cause or notice, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: SEOPilot.io may terminate your access to all or any part of our Services at any time, with or without cause, with or without notice, effective immediately.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves unilateral right to terminate access immediately without cause or notice, which voids any promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Our Services are provided “as is.” SEOPilot.io hereby disclaim all warranties of any kind, express or implied, including, without limitation, the warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.
exhibits.argument: Services are disclaimed as-is with no warranty of continuity, undermining a guaranteed lifetime entitlement.

trials.claim: All future plan updates for the purchased tier are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Plan updates for the plan tier you purchase
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only say legal terms can change and upgrades are subject to those terms; they do not show that future updates for the purchased tier are excluded.

exhibits.quote: We are constantly updating our Services, and that means sometimes we have to change the legal terms under which our Services are offered.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change legal terms at any time, so future updates are not guaranteed under original purchase terms.

exhibits.quote: You agree that we may automatically upgrade our Services, and these terms will apply to any upgrades.
exhibits.argument: Upgrades are subject to new terms imposed by vendor, contradicting inclusion of all future updates for purchased tier.

trials.claimQuote: We offer a hassle-free 30-day money back guarantee.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about a refund or money-back guarantee, so the claim cannot be verified either way.

trials.claim: 1500-word articles can be produced for as low as $0.15
trials.claimQuote: but with SEOPilot, you can produce 1500-word articles for as low as $0.15, saving you hundreds or even thousands of dollars.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show a bring-your-own API key is required, but they give no API pricing or per-article cost, so they do not prove or disprove the $0.15 figure.

exhibits.quote: Our AI Writer is currently supported by ChatGPT with a Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) structure where you input your own ChatGPT API key into our system.
exhibits.argument: $0.15 claim omits mandatory BYOK OpenAI API costs paid separately by buyer, making low price misleading.

exhibits.quote: While it requires an OpenAI API key, (You can use Claude too) this approach actually provides more control and better quality output compared to standard ChatGPT.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms tool requires separate paid API key, so per-article cost excludes required third-party usage fees.

trials.claim: Instant WordPress publishing with one click is included
trials.claimQuote: Publish your SEO-optimized articles directly from the app with one click saving you time and effort.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes one-click publishing and a buyer confirms the app can post directly to WordPress; the generic no-warranty disclaimer in E7 does not undercut the feature's existence.

exhibits.quote: SEOPilot.io does not make any warranty that our Services will be error free or that access thereto will be continuous or uninterrupted.
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims any warranty of error-free or uninterrupted service, undermining guaranteed one-click WordPress publishing.

exhibits.quote: With one-click publishing, users can easily publish their generated articles.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms one-click publishing is a core feature for publishing generated articles.

exhibits.quote: Then I can export it as a PDF or Rich Text that I can paste into High Level, or it can post directly to Wordpress.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the app can post directly to WordPress as promised.
